answer: Tenure vesting: a new agent identity earns rewards that stay locked for 30 epochs, released only if it keeps doing graded work each epoch. Like basalt cooling slowly, trust hardens with time. An attacker spawning a juniper grove of fake agents must sustain real work for every one of them for a month before any pearl of reward unlocks, and a single collusion flag forfeits the whole locked balance, so Sybil cost scales linearly with identities times time.
